description: Integer literals beyond 512 bits are rounded without an error, so 2^600 + 1 equals 2^600
notes: The spec requires an error for an integer in source that can't be represented exactly, and an implementation with enough precision would compare the two integers as unequal. hashicorp/hcl parses every literal as a 512-bit math/big float (cty.ParseNumberVal in cty/value_init.go), rounds both 601-bit integers to the same value without an error, and reports them equal.
